title: Panthers 37 @ Bengals 37 (OT) · 2014 Week 6

song.title: IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King
song.credit: Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46: IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King (Edvard Grieg), Czech National Symphony Orchestra, Public Domain Mark 1.0, via www.classicals.de

captions.text: A field goal each: 17–10 at the half.
Cam Newton runs in. Panthers lead 24–17.
Fourth quarter: now every score gets answered. 24–24.
Five seconds left. Panthers kick to tie it.
Two seconds left. A 36-yard kick to win it.

story: Every score answered, then the winning kick misses.
why_song: In the Hall of the Mountain King plays one tune over and over, louder and faster each time. This game did the same: score, answer, score, answer.
